title: QUANTITY OF ROYAL ALBERT 'TEND...
reason: About 15 pieces of Royal Albert Tenderness bone china (cream soups, stands, bowls) with the backstamp read; named maker but a less sought pattern, roughly $80 to $140 as a lot.
findings: Photo 1: four two-handled cream soup cups, four saucer stands and a stack of seven small bowls, all with pink and yellow rose sprays and gilt scalloped rims (about 15 pieces). Photo 2: a saucer backstamp reading ROYAL ALBERT / Bone China / ENGLAND / TENDERNESS with a rose spray and the number 41 below, which supports the title. Tenderness is not one of the top-selling Royal Albert patterns, but cream soups and stands are the more wanted pieces.
condition: Gilt rim wear and rubbing visible on the saucer in photo 2 and along some rims; no cracks or chips seen at this resolution.
rescore_note: About 15 pieces of Royal Albert Tenderness (four cream soups with stands, a stack of small bowls), named maker but a common mid-range pattern with gilt wear; my estimate about $60 to $90 for the lot (no live comps).
